title: Startup Admission And Discovery Artifact
description: Normative startup-admission-discovery artifact contract per 00-canonical.md §8 and AD23. This schema is owned by M2a and consumed unchanged by later emission milestones.

admission.description: Admission decision output summarizing the selected source, companion target, warmup timing, and degraded reason when applicable.

state.description: Admission state label emitted by the startup-admission FSM.

source.description: Selected initiator/source address as an unsigned byte.

companion_target.description: Selected companion target address as an unsigned byte.

reason_if_degraded.description: Human-readable degraded reason. May be an empty string for non-degraded paths.

transport_kind.description: Transport kind from the startup-admission capability matrix. 'adapter-direct' is the multiplexer mode that wraps an underlying ENH/ENS adapter; semantically equivalent to a source-selection-capable transport (main.go special-cases it to admissionPath=SourceSelectionCapable).

admission_path_selected.description: Admission path chosen by the startup-admission flow.

discovery.description: Discovery-phase evidence summary emitted alongside admission state for later observability and artifact consumers.

wire_bytes.description: Total observed wire bytes in the discovery window.

startup_burst_pct.description: Percentage of total probes concentrated in the startup burst interval.

post_startup_sustained_rate_probes_per_1.description: Steady-state probe rate normalized to probes per 15 seconds.

probe_count.description: Total probe count observed during the discovery window.

promoted_suspects_without_identity.description: Count of promoted suspects that still lack identity resolution.

per_baseline_address_evidence_counts.description: Per-baseline-address evidence counts keyed by two-digit hex address strings.

propertyNames.description: Address key as a two-digit hexadecimal string without prefix.

additionalProperties.description: Evidence count recorded for the keyed baseline address.
